A small dragon lies coiled on a glittering treasure-hoard in a side-vault deep in the hold.
A colossal stone golem stands sentinel at the hall's far end, runes glowing faintly on its chest.
A vast underground waterfall pours from a high opening into the dark far below the bridge.
A great forge-spirit surges upward from the central furnace, its body a roaring column of living flame.
A freshly hewn vein of glowing blue crystal cuts across the cavern wall, pulsing with cold inner light.
Dust and rubble drift slowly from a recent cave-in, half-burying a corridor at the chamber's edge.
A balrog-like presence smolders in the deepest dark below, its furnace-glow bleeding red through a floor grate.
A procession of dwarven warriors marches through the hall bearing tall clan banners and a sealed iron chest.
A dragon-shaped statue looms over the main gate, its carved eyes burning with steady amber fire.
An entire wall bristles with legendary weapons racked in iron cradles, each blade inscribed with runes of war.
A rope-and-chain bridge sways violently over a chasm as cracks race along its anchor bolts.
A fire-elemental writhes inside the forge pit, its tendrils of flame licking up the stone chimney walls.
A tiny copper-scaled dragon perches atop a coin pile, watching arrivals with one half-lidded golden eye.
Crystal veins branch across the ceiling overhead, shedding shifting violet radiance onto the dwarves below.
Plumes of grey cave-in dust roll silently through an archway, coating everything in pale powdery silence.
An ancient stone golem raises one massive fist toward the vault above, frozen mid-swing for centuries.
Deep below a grated shaft, something enormous breathes, and its breath rises as shimmering heat through the floor.
The underground waterfall crashes into a black pool, sending perpetual mist drifting across the lower passages.
A funeral procession carries a dwarf-lord's armored body on a shield, torches lighting the carved stone corridor.
Twin dragon-head pillars frame the throne arch, their gem-set eyes tracking movement with faint mechanical clicks.
Dozens of named axes, hammers, and swords hang in a precise grid, each weapon humming softly with old power.
The chasm bridge groans and tilts as a massive stalactite crashes down beside its central span.
A forge-spirit bends low over an anvil, hammering ghostly blows that ring out across the entire hold.
A vein of red-gold ore glows molten-bright where a pickaxe just struck, startling the miner who found it.
A banner procession halts mid-hall as drums begin echoing from somewhere deeper, unannounced and growing louder.
